feature: Stop hook counter ignored by git
description: ensure_ignored adds stop-blocks.json to .hexa/.gitignore alongside the task ledger's runtime files, without duplicating lines or changing anything else

specs.description: hexa init in a fresh project ignores the Stop hook's counter
specs.given: an empty directory with no .hexa directory
specs.then: .hexa/.gitignore contains a line exactly `stop-blocks.json`, alongside `tasks.json`, `tasks.lock` and `.tasks.json.*.tmp`

specs.description: A task ledger write in an existing project adds the missing line
specs.given: an existing project whose .hexa/.gitignore holds only `tasks.json`, `tasks.lock` and `.tasks.json.*.tmp`
specs.when: the task ledger writes (for example, a task is added)
specs.then: .hexa/.gitignore also contains `stop-blocks.json`, and the three earlier lines are still present

specs.description: After init the counter file does not show in git status
specs.given: a git repository initialised by hexa init, where the Stop hook has since written .hexa/stop-blocks.json
specs.then: no line names .hexa/stop-blocks.json, and `git check-ignore .hexa/stop-blocks.json` reports it as ignored

specs.description: A line already present is not written twice
specs.given: a .hexa/.gitignore that already contains `stop-blocks.json` and all the task ledger's lines
specs.when: ensure_ignored runs again, through hexa init or a task ledger write
specs.then: the file content is byte-for-byte unchanged and `stop-blocks.json` appears exactly once

specs.description: A user's own lines are kept and the counter line is not duplicated around them
specs.given: a .hexa/.gitignore that contains `stop-blocks.json` and a user-added line `notes.md`, but lacks `tasks.lock`
specs.then: only `tasks.lock` is added, `notes.md` is kept, and `stop-blocks.json` still appears exactly once

specs.description: For any starting content, ensure_ignored leaves every required line present exactly once and is idempotent
specs.given: any starting .hexa/.gitignore content, including absent, empty, or any subset or ordering of the required lines plus arbitrary other lines
specs.when: ensure_ignored runs once, and then runs a second time
specs.then: after the first run each of `tasks.json`, `tasks.lock`, `.tasks.json.*.tmp` and `stop-blocks.json` occurs exactly once, every other line that was there before is kept, and the second run changes nothing

specs.description: The task ledger's existing ignore lines are still written
specs.then: .hexa/.gitignore contains `tasks.json`, `tasks.lock` and `.tasks.json.*.tmp`, as it did before this ADR

specs.description: The root .gitignore is not changed by this decision
specs.then: the root .gitignore equals what merged_gitignore produces for the project floor's lines, and it does not contain `stop-blocks.json` or `.hexa/stop-blocks.json`

specs.description: What the Stop hook records is unchanged
specs.given: a project after hexa init, and a session id for which the Stop hook blocks a stop twice in a row
specs.then: it still writes .hexa/stop-blocks.json with a consecutive-block count of 2 for that session id; the file is not moved, renamed or left unwritten

specs.description: For any existing root .gitignore, merged_gitignore gives the same result as before
specs.then: the result is the same as with the pre-ADR floor lines from gitignore_lines, which contain no entry naming stop-blocks.json

amendments.reason: S09's setup could never make the Stop hook block: it edited an untracked file (the hook reads tracked files only) and ran the hooks without the session id in the environment, as Claude Code sets it. The fixture now commits the file first and run_hook passes the payload's session_id as HEXA_SESSION_ID; no assertion changes. S09 passes without the fix: a guard recorded red only for its setup
